mentions.name: OpenScout
mentions.description: A social listening tool that tracks brand and product mentions across Reddit, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Hacker News, aimed at helping early-stage SaaS founders with brand visibility and go-to-market. It deliberately avoids bot-based solutions to stay within platform terms of service.
mentions.problem: Early-stage SaaS founders struggle with brand visibility; building has commoditized, making go-to-market the real challenge.
mentions.source_excerpt: Right now, actively building and growing https://OpenScout.so which is a tool for tracking mentions on Reddit, Linkedin, Twitter and HN. This is primarily made for early stage SaaS founders to help them with brand visibility problem.
